// Two `for…of` loops reuse the variable name `c`. A file-global name→array map
// would let the LAST declaration win and hide the real wipe entirely.
process.env.NODE_ENV = 'local';

const { db } = require('../../src/utils/firebase');
const { clearCollection } = require('../helpers/firebase-emulator');

const WIPED = ['users', 'rooms'];
const MERELY_LOGGED = ['scratch'];

beforeEach(async () => {
  for (const c of WIPED) await clearCollection(db, c);
});

test('an unrelated loop reuses the same variable name', () => {
  for (const c of MERELY_LOGGED) expect(c).toBe('scratch');
});
